We don’t hire a list of skills and accomplishments. We hire people.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements for one of our open positions, apply anyway! If the position would make you come in to work with a smile on your face every day, we want you here. We love your enthusiasm!

Kaltura is an equal opportunity employer whose core values – openness, flexibility, and collaboration – are based on mutual respect, kindness, and empathy. We’re committed to creating and maintaining a welcoming, safe, and inclusive environment for all our diverse employees, candidates, partners, and customers, and stand firmly behind our zero-tolerance policy regarding any discrimination or harassment based on, among others, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, ethnic or national origin, political affiliation, union membership, military/reserve duty, or family status.
